title: Book Two · Chapter 108: The Closed Room
story:
On Wednesday, dark clouds fill the sky after lunch. Ronan stands near the window and watches the first drops hit the yard.

Jun picks up his bag.

“Are you coming?”

“In a minute.”

Jun leaves with the tree book. Ronan waits until the classroom is almost empty. Then he follows.

Five younger pupils are in the passage. One holds a guide flat against his chest. Another has a long folder for picture sheets. Jun stands beside the locked materials room.

“The teacher may be late,” he says.

Ronan stops at the reading room door. The white notice is just beyond Jun. The word Thursday is clear.

A girl goes close to the notice.

“It says tomorrow.”

Jun turns. He reads it once, then takes a guide from the boy.

“Wednesday,” he says quietly.

The boy with the folder asks, “Which one is right?”

Jun looks toward Ronan. “Did the teacher tell you about a change?”

All five pupils look at Ronan.

“Maybe there is another time today,” he says.

Jun tries the door once. It stays shut.

A teacher passes through the passage. Jun asks her about the room. She points to the notice.

“Thursday this term. The teacher has another class on Wednesday.”

The boy with the folder looks at the rain.

“I stayed at school for this. My sister is at the gate.”

He closes his folder. The girl folds her guide into a small square. They leave together.

Jun says, “I told him to come.”

He points to the younger boy beside him. The boy holds Jun's tree book.

“I can give it back now,” the boy says.

“Keep it until Friday. We can find the picture tomorrow.”

“But I cannot stay tomorrow.”

Jun takes a breath. “Then bring it on Friday.”

The boy puts the book under his guide and hurries toward the stairs. Rain blows through the open side of the passage. Jun calls to him to put the book in his bag. The boy stops and does it.

Jun turns back to Ronan.

“You said you asked.”

Ronan looks at the locked door.

“I went there.”

“That is not my question.”

The bell rings. Jun lifts his bag.

“I need the leaf sheet for my own page, too. I cannot finish it today now.”

“We can use something else.”

“I asked you to check the time. That was your part.”

Jun walks toward class. Ronan follows several steps behind him. His shoes make a wet sound on the stone. At the stairs, he presses one heel down. Water comes out along the edge.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

locked＝锁着的；change＝变动；stay＝留下；several＝几个。

## 理解问题

1. 新生因小册子白等了什么？
2. Jun为什么不能按计划完成自己的阅读页？

## 读句子

**Jun / turns back / to Ronan.** Jun／转回身面向／Ronan。
